one_liner: external unprivileged attacker can extract ~$0 live from Serum Swap (all 292 pools, $204-259k TVL): withdrawals are gated by the caller's own LP-token burn, swaps are fair curve trades (only $4.22 of realizable mispricing), and the deployed 2021-04 build's single-sided withdrawal over-charges rather than under-charges; $140.7k of value is key-gated to the SPL fee account and the program remains upgradeable by the non-revoked authority DpWjxjJE2SC.
